description.value: A riverside campground in the boreal forest along the Alaska Highway in Northern BC, offering a quiet break from highway miles beside the Tetsa River; facilities are basic with 25 sites.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies Tetsa River Regional Park as a legitimate tourism=camp_site operated by the Northern Rockies Regional District, with capacity=25 and payment:cash=yes as the only amenity-level tags. The linked Tourism Northern Rockies listing URL returns a 404 Page Not Found, so no campground-specific amenity details can be confirmed from the website; the subpages fetched are all general regional tourism pages unrelated to this campground. All optional amenity fields default to null due to absence of positive evidence from either source beyond basic OSM identifiers.
concerns: The OSM listing URL returns a 404 Page Not Found — the specific campground listing has been removed from the Tourism Northern Rockies website, leaving no web-based confirmation of amenities or contact details.
OSM phone +1-250-774-7544 could not be confirmed via website content; the Tourism Northern Rockies general contact number is 250-774-6400, which differs.
No address is recorded in OSM; physical location is only inferrable from coordinates (along the Alaska Highway, Northern BC).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Tetsa River Regional Park is a real, publicly accessible campground operated by a regional district authority; the broken tourism listing URL does not indicate closure, and OSM flags confirm it is not considered closed.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM capacity=25 and payment:cash=yes are the only amenity-level data points available. A direct website for the Northern Rockies Regional District operator may provide additional detail not accessible through the tourism listing.
